memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Long-term memories of the Life layer: summaries, facts, episodes and notes.
memory.searchHint: Fill in both the session and the search text.
memory.deleteHint: Deleted memories cannot be recovered. Continue?

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Known people, relationship scores and profile facts per session.
people.empty: No people recorded in this session
people.deleteHint: Deleting the person or a fact cannot be undone. Continue?

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.subtitle: Phrasings learned from chat: situation, style, weight and usage.
expressions.empty: No expressions learned in this session
expressions.deleteHint: It will no longer be injected. Continue?

jargon.title: Slang
jargon.subtitle: Group terms and meanings; pending terms can be approved or rejected.
jargon.empty: No slang recorded in this session
jargon.deleteHint: The term and its meaning will be removed. Continue?

emojis.title: Stickers
emojis.subtitle: Collected stickers and tags; disabled ones are never sent.
emojis.empty: No stickers collected in this session
emojis.deleteHint: The file will be removed too. Continue?

focus.title: Focus Timeline
focus.subtitle: Turn timeline, folded digest and checkpoints per session.
focus.deleteHint: The session digest and turns will be lost. Continue?

monitor.title: Planner Monitor
monitor.subtitle: Heart-flow decisions and outbound replies; reasoning excerpts are capped.

rollout.title: Rollout Board
rollout.subtitle: Stable per-group percentage rollout; shadow records without sending. Set the percentage to 0 to roll back.
rollout.configHint: Restart the bot after saving; 0% or shadow mode is the fastest rollback.

migration.title: Data Migration
migration.subtitle: Export memory, preview and roll back MaiBot imports; writes are done by the CLI.
migration.memoryHint: Export memories as JSON for backup or migration.
migration.statusHint: Current runtime status, useful to confirm the migration target.
migration.configHint: Edit and save; invalid fields are rejected.
migration.importHint: Preview is read-only. Run scripts/life/migrate.py import in the CLI for the real import, so a long request cannot block the panel.
migration.rollbackText: This deletes the row-id range written by batch {batch}; live rows created after the import are kept. Continue?
